# Palash Ranjan Roy (Palash Roy)

> Palash Ranjan Roy — also known as Palash Roy, Ranjan Roy, or P. R. Roy — is a Computer Science
> PhD researcher and Software Engineering researcher at the University of Saskatchewan, Canada.
> His research focuses on code clone detection, code refactoring, and applying large language
> models (LLMs) to software engineering. He is a winner of the ACM SIGSOFT Distinguished Paper
> Award (FSE 2026) and served as President of the University of Saskatchewan Graduate Students'
> Association (2025-2026).

Official website: https://palashroy.me

## Identity
- Full name: Palash Ranjan Roy
- Also known as: Palash Roy, Ranjan Roy, P. R. Roy, Palash R. Roy
- Role: PhD Researcher in Computer Science; Software Engineering researcher
- Affiliation: University of Saskatchewan (Software Research Lab / SRLab and Interactive Software Engineering Lab / ISELab)
- Advisor: Dr. Kevin Schneider
- Location: Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, Canada (originally from Bangladesh)
- Research areas: code clones, clone detection, clone refactoring, large language models for software engineering, AI-driven software engineering
